args.title: Corvid Packaging: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Combined summary of the Corvid Packaging newsletter, its linked article, and the companion piece:

• Corvid Packaging's latest newsletter covers warehouse automation in 2026, linking to a feature article and a companion piece (the latter accessible via a team licence link).
• Main article: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
